messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Pool=opalcloud-ded-1 node=12 GPU thermal trip detected, automatic eviction started. Impact: ongoing task evictions, ~12 affected tasks. Severity=P1. Pager: @oncall-eng. Details: https://redwood.incidents/2281234567

oncall-eng: ack — I'm on it. Pulling logs from node-12 now. @sre-ash can you join?

sre-ash: joining. running `dedpool status --pool opalcloud-ded-1` to get current distribution.

eng-runtime-leo: FYI this pool runs latency-sensitive KV workloads for opal-tenant-A. We should avoid cold-starts for that tenant if possible.

infra-jun: quickly looked at metrics — GPU temp spike to 108C, NVLINK errors showing up around the same time. Likely hardware thermal trip, not just driver.

oncall-eng: paste logs?

sre-ash: paste below:

```
NODE   ID: node-12
GPU0   TEMP: 108C
STATE: EVACUATING
RUNNING_TASKS: 12
TENANTS: opal-tenant-A, opal-tenant-B
ERRS: pcie_aer: 5  nvlink: 3
```

ops-lina: recommend immediate isolation of node-12, start draining tenants, and increase burst/reserved capacity in us-west-2 to shift load while we replace hardware. I'm kicking off the autoscale now. ETA ~90s.

solutions-ricardo: pinged OpalCloud engineering lead in DM. Customer is reporting elevated latencies and some failed batch jobs. They've asked for opal-tenant-A to be prioritized.

oncall-eng: plan: 1) cordon node-12, 2) drain tenants with 2m grace to allow polite shutdowns, 3) route new requests to hosted fallback + other dedicated nodes, 4) open CHG for hardware replacement. I'll own routing and customer comms while infra handles replacement.

eng-runtime-leo: important: we'll stagger tenant moves so opal-tenant-A warms caches first. Use `--order opal-tenant-A` when draining.

customer-opalcloud-eng: confirming — we see ~5% error rate on batch inference since ~06:12 UTC. Opal prefers minimal disruption but will accept maintenance if needed. Prioritize opal-tenant-A please.

sre-ash: executing drain now:

```
$ dedpool cordon node-12 --pool opalcloud-ded-1
$ dedpool drain node-12 --pool opalcloud-ded-1 --tenants opal-tenant-A,opal-tenant-B --grace 120 --order opal-tenant-A
```

incident-bot: Drain initiated for node-12. 12 running tasks -> requeued across pool. Expected drain completion: ~3m.

oncall-eng: applying route-policy fallback for pool to hosted endpoints and other dedicated nodes: `route-policy apply opalcloud-ded-1 fallback-hosted`

ops-lina: reserved-burst capacity up and healthy. New nodes joined pool: ded-spot-19, ded-resv-04. Rebalancer starting.

infra-jun: opened change CHG-5591: hot-swap GPU board for node-12. ETA vendor tech on-site 1.5h. Ordering parts now. For now node-12 state -> QUARANTINED after drain.

pm-janet: notifying CS and AM; prepping incident comms (customer-facing brief + internal timeline).

solutions-ricardo: I've left a short note in the OpalCloud customer channel with the mitigation steps and ETA. They asked about interim SLA credit — flagging to AMs.

oncall-eng: monitor window starting. @sre-ash please watch for requeue storms or backpressure on the frontend.

sre-ash: drain completed — all tenant tasks moved off node-12. Requeues: 12 -> redistributed. Watching latency.

eng-runtime-leo: observing a transient latency spike for opal-tenant-B (~200ms) during KV warmup, opal-tenant-A is stable after warmup.

incident-bot: Node 12 state: QUARANTINED. Eviction count: 3. Ticket INF-9876 created and linked to CHG-5591.

oncall-eng: handing off to infra-jun for hardware replacement work. I'm stepping off primary pager but staying on thread watch.

infra-jun: taking over. Onsite tech starting diagnostics, will attempt board hot-swap. Will post proc updates here.

ops-lina: leaving ops note in the customer channel with final drain confirmation and new node names. :thumbsup:

sre-ash: moving to monitoring watch for 30m. If errors persist, re-escalate.

infra-jun: replacement successful. Ran post-replace health checks:

```
$ node-health-check node-12
CHECKS: psu OK, nvlink OK, gpu temp nominal 45C, mem test pass
STATUS: HEALTHY
```

infra-jun: returning node-12 to rotation and marking for 30m soak. Rebalancer redistributed tasks back per policy.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> severity downgraded to P3. Closing window in 30m pending soak completion.

customer-opalcloud-eng: thanks team — we'll validate on our side and confirm. Appreciate the priority on tenant-A.

oncall-eng: noted. Follow-ups: postmortem prep (pm-janet + sre-ash), SLA escalation (solutions-ricardo -> AM), change review (infra-jun). Closing on-call handover.

sre-ash: adding logs/metrics to INF-9876 for the postmortem.

pm-janet: I'll draft a customer-friendly summary and internal RCA template. We'll schedule a RCA review tomorrow.

incident-bot: Thread archived in 24h unless reopened."
